dialogues.speaker: Bystrov
dialogues.text: Come on, man, you can't keep living like this. You've got to do right by Zhemchuzhina.

dialogues.speaker: Serebrov
dialogues.text: Hic... What was that you were saying just now?

dialogues.speaker: Bystrov
dialogues.text: You're drunk again... You really ought to learn a trade. Life won't always be this hard, but you need to think about the future, about how you're going to support your family and look after for Zhemchuzhina.

dialogues.speaker: Serebrov
dialogues.text: Hic... Honestly, I think I need to stay far away from her. She can take care of herself.

dialogues.speaker: Serebrov
dialogues.text: It... it'd be better if she ran away too.

dialogues.speaker: Serebrov
dialogues.text: That way... when those gang members track me down... I'll have nothing left to fear...

dialogues.speaker: Bystrov
dialogues.text: ...Don't worry. Those gang members will never find this place.

dialogues.speaker: Serebrov
dialogues.text: But... then what can I even do for her? *sob*...

dialogues.speaker: Bystrov
dialogues.text: Hey, don't cry. Tell you what, I'm planning to make some time to teach Belsky some repair work. You can learn right alongside him. How does that sound?
